title: Group Chat and Scholarship
author: Rosalind Winterbourne
blurb: Tamsin Joubert, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
